item.title: Biometric Attendance System Guide for Qatar — Face Recognition & Fingerprint Compared
item.description: Biometric attendance systems eliminate buddy punching and automate payroll. This guide compares face recognition and fingerprint scanners, explains how many devices you need, and covers installation in Qatar.
